name: io.github.JessieJanie/skim402
description: URLs to clean markdown for agents. Free card key (sk402_) at skim402.com; wallet/x402 optional.

headers.name: X-Skim-Wallet-Key
headers.description: Optional x402 wallet key. Recommended path is a card API key (sk402_) from https://skim402.com/pricing — use the npm package env SKIM_API_KEY. Without this header, skim_read works on the shared free tier. For wallet pay: a fresh, low-balance Base wallet private key.

environmentVariables.name: SKIM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Recommended. Card-plan API key (sk402_...). Get a free key at https://skim402.com/pricing. Takes priority over SKIM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY. Enables read_url, read_urls, extract_url, crawl_url, read_pdf, watch, and poll_signal without a wallet.

environmentVariables.name: SKIM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Base-network wallet private key (0x-prefixed, 64 hex chars) for x402 pay-per-call if you are not using SKIM_API_KEY. Fund with a small amount of USDC on Base. Ignored when SKIM_API_KEY is set.

environmentVariables.name: SKIM_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional cap on per-call price in USD (default 0.01). Wallet lane only. Raise (e.g. 0.05) for batch/extract/watch. Requests that would cost more than this are rejected without payment.
